prompt: Create an abstract expressionist painting in monochromatic shades of deep pink and white. The composition features a bold, horse head that resembles a creature or figure, with large brushstrokes conveying texture and movement. The top of the form extends upwards with irregular, almost skeletal lines, while the lower section is denser and more detailed, giving a sense of depth and mass. The brushstrokes are raw and gestural, with splatters and smears that lend an expressive, emotional intensity to the piece. The background is mostly white, creating a stark contrast that makes the pink shape feel dynamic and almost three-dimensional. The artwork has an unfinished quality, as if capturing a moment in time or an evolving concept, evoking both strength and mystery. --chaos 15 --ar 4:3 --style raw --v 6.1
